info.name: List Detection 360 reports for a specific type of detection misclassification.

params.name: inquiry_type
params.description: Whether to fetch missed attacks or false positives.

params.name: start
params.description: The start of the datetime range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp, to fetch Detection 360 cases from. Defaults to 30 days before end.

params.name: end
params.description: The end of the datetime range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp, to fetch Detection 360 cases from. Defaults to the current time.

params.name: status
params.description: Only Detection 360 cases with these statuses will be retrieved. Defaults to all statuses.

items.docs: Get a list of Detection 360 reports that you have submitted and view corresponding details for each case, including report summaries, statuses, message analyses, and more.

Use this to report a detection misclassification judgement by Abnormal Security.  We use this data to improve our models, and also give customers transparency into the frequency of misclassifications.
